panels.headline: The Walks Are Getting Longer
panels.body: I still can't believe you rated hospital soup with a spreadsheet. Only you. And those socks—crime against textile history. But look at you, mayor of tiny walks, out here redefining progress. One step, one spoon, one basil leaf at a time. So proud of you. Rest well, heal fully. —Jordan
